headline: Closed ports and new EU restrictions: how much money Ukraine loses monthly
summary: Russian strikes and a port blockade could cut Ukrainian steel production by 30-40%, according to the report. It estimates losses of up to 200 million from the closures and new EU restrictions.
why: Ukraine's seaports handle much of its grain and metal exports, so port closures affect export revenue, the hryvnia and the state budget.
